records.name: FORMER GATEWAY BOYS' SCHOOL
records.use: former boys' school / former town house converted and extended for school use
records.field_evidence: Former Gateway Boys' School; former town house converted and extended in 1931, establishing school use.

records.name: FORMER STONEYGATE SCHOOL
records.field_evidence: Former Stoneygate School; listed entry describes the former school building at Scholars Walk.

records.name: FORMER BARCLAYS BANK
records.field_evidence: Former bank circa 1900-1910 at 10 Horsefair Street.

records.name: CHURCH OF ST PETER
records.field_evidence: Church of St Peter; 1872-79 Gothic church with nave, aisles, transept, polygonal apse and west tower.

records.name: HYDRAULIC ACCUMULATOR TOWER, ENGINE HOUSE, BOILER HOUSE AND ANCILLARY BUILDING
records.use: hydraulic power house / engine and boiler house / ancillary building
records.field_evidence: Late C19 Midland Railway hydraulic accumulator tower with attached engine and boiler house and detached ancillary building; hydraulic energy production function.

records.name: 53 AND 55, MARKET PLACE
records.field_evidence: Historic England official list entry describes a late-C19 four-storey building and states that a large shop was being fitted at the time of the 1973 survey.

records.name: EXCHANGE BUILDING
records.field_evidence: Historic England official list entry explicitly describes the Exchange Building as shops and offices; it dates the building to 1888 and identifies Stockdale Harrison of Leicester as designer.

records.name: 98-104, NEW WALK
records.field_evidence: Historic England official list entry describes 98-104 New Walk as an early-C19 terrace, with the statutory building description covering the connected row of houses.

records.name: 146-154, UPPER NEW WALK
records.field_evidence: Historic England official list entry explicitly describes a row of 5 terrace houses, 146-154 Upper New Walk, built 1884-1888.

records.name: 75, MARKET PLACE
records.field_evidence: Historic England official list entry describes a late-C18 building and identifies a tall modern ground-floor bank front of stone.
